skill.name: cfn-skill-management
skill.description: Skill loading, propagation, and building for CFN. Use when dynamically discovering and loading skills, deploying skills across environments, or creating new skill scaffolding.
skill.body:
# Skill Management Skill (Mega-Skill)

**Version:** 1.0.0
**Purpose:** Skill loading, propagation, and building for CFN
**Status:** Production
**Consolidates:** cfn-skill-loader, cfn-skill-propagation, cfn-skill-builder

---

## Overview

This mega-skill provides complete skill lifecycle management:
- **Loader** - Dynamic skill discovery and loading
- **Propagation** - Skill deployment across environments
- **Builder** - New skill creation and scaffolding

---

## Directory Structure

```
skill-management/
├── SKILL.md
├── lib/
│   ├── loader/           # From cfn-skill-loader
│   ├── propagation/      # From cfn-skill-propagation
│   └── builder/          # From cfn-skill-builder
└── cli/
```

---

## Migration Paths

| Old Path | New Path |
|----------|----------|
| cfn-skill-loader/ | skill-management/lib/loader/ |
| cfn-skill-propagation/ | skill-management/lib/propagation/ |
| cfn-skill-builder/ | skill-management/lib/builder/ |

---

## Version History

### 1.0.0 (2025-12-02)
- Consolidated 3 skill management skills into mega-skill

generated_query: I'm building a new skill to convert markdown to HTML. I need to create the scaffolding for it, then deploy it to both my development and production environments. Also, I want to make sure that when the system starts, it automatically discovers and loads all skills from the shared repository, including this new one. Can you help me set that up?

edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the Builder capability means the skill cannot create scaffolding for new skills, which the user needs.
Deleting the migration path for the builder further obscures the builder functionality, making the skill incomplete.
